listingboard, t.LISTING_DATE listingdate, t.DELISTING_DATE delistingdate, CASE WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '沪股通' THEN '01' WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '深股通' THEN '02' WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '否' THEN '03' END ishorsexpress, CASE WHEN t.IS_MARGIN_TRADING = '是' THEN 'Y' WHEN t.IS_MARGIN_TRADING = '否' THEN 'N' END ismargintrading, CCY ccy, t.TRADE_CALENDER tradecalender, CASE WHEN t.STOCK_TYPE = '普通股' THEN '01' WHEN t.STOCK_TYPE = '优先股' THEN '02' WHEN t.STOCK_TYPE = '其他' THEN '99' ELSE t.STOCK_TYPE END stocktype, nvl(sd.item_code,t.INDUSTRY_N) as industrynSecond, sl.linked_item_code industryn, updateuser, t.COMPANY_CODE companycode, '01' type1, CASE WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '沪股通' THEN '103' WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '深股通' THEN '104' WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '否' AND t.TRADE_PLACE = '上海证券交易所' THEN '101' WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '否' AND t.TRADE_PLACE = '深圳证券交易所' THEN '102' END type2, CASE WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '沪股通' THEN 'L03' WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '深股通' THEN 'L04' WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '否' AND t.TRADE_PLACE = '上海证券交易所' THEN 'L01' WHEN t.IS_HORS_EXPRESS = '否' AND t.TRADE_PLACE = '深圳证券交易所' THEN 'L02' END type3, 'F11' type8 FROM INTERF_STOCK_INFO t LEFT JOIN sys_datadict_list sd ON sd.dict_code = 'INSTITUTION_INDUSTRY_SECOND_LEVEL' AND sd.item_code = t.INDUSTRY_N LEFT JOIN sys_datadict_list_link sl ON sl.dict_code = 'INSTITUTION_INDUSTRY_SECOND_LEVEL' AND
